description: This file is a shell script named 'generate-cmdlist.sh' used to generate C code for command listing, categories, and documentation processing for a project. It defines functions for command filtering, category handling, and produces a C source snippet with command categories and help info based on input text files.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Outputs an error message to stderr and exits with status 1.

methods.name: command_list
methods.description: Reads commands from a file, filtering out comments, empty lines, and excluded programs, then outputs the command list.

methods.name: category_list
methods.description: Extracts and sorts unique category identifiers from a string.

methods.name: define_categories
methods.description: Defines categories as bit flags in C code, checking for excessive number.

methods.name: define_category_names
methods.description: Creates an array of category name strings for C code.

methods.name: print_command_list
methods.description: Generates a C array of command names and help info, incorporating documentation and category flags.
